caseName: Simmons v. West Haven Housing Authority
caseNameFull: Simmons et ux. v. West Haven Housing Authority
attorneys: Robert K. Killian, Attorney General, and F. Michael Ahern, Assistant Attorney General, for the State of Connecticut on its motion.

opinions.text: Appeal from App. Div., Cir. Ct. Conn. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 394 U.
